description: This file contains unit tests for the LaunchAgentManager component in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the plist configuration for launching an app on login and its behavior after manual termination.

classes.name: LaunchAgentManagerTests
classes.description: A structure that encapsulates tests related to the LaunchAgentManager functionality.

methods.name: launch at login plist does not keep app alive after manual quit
methods.description: A test method that verifies that the launch at login plist does not keep the app running after it has been manually quit. It checks the 'RunAtLoad' and 'KeepAlive' keys, as well as the program arguments.
